subheadline: From a few Fluid templates to 244 content elements with their own theme system.

events.title: First public release
events.description: Desiderio 1.0 brought shadcn/ui styling to TYPO3 Content Blocks, with backend previews from the start.

events.title: A shared component layer
events.description: The component layer arrived. Today it has 17 atoms, 37 molecules, 4 layouts and 4 organisms, shared by every element.

events.title: 15 theme presets
events.description: Ten house presets, from Aurora to Citrus, joined the five shadcn presets. Switching one changes the site at runtime.

events.title: Per-page presets in 2.6
events.description: Each page and its subpages can now use their own theme preset. The styleguide uses a different one for each chapter.
